comment: Tracked test files that are NOT run anywhere: neither wired into a chain/CI/script nor part of the pnpm run test:unwired sweep. Every entry must carry a reason — a test nobody runs is a defect, not coverage. scripts/test-chain-coverage.mjs --check fails on stale entries (file wired/deleted) and reason-less entries; remove an entry the moment its reason no longer holds. The 2026-11-19 batch: per-file sweep of all 610 then-unwired files (570 green joined the sweep tier, 40 red excluded here until someone revives them against current behavior).
